approved_differences.statement: No behavior difference is approved in this internal capability slice. The observed differences between the two legacy routes are future parity requirements, not migration differences.

catalog_application_contract.runtime_sql: SELECT DISTINCT q.type AS question_type FROM questions q

result_semantics.source_values: exact questions.type values; no trim, case folding, alias conversion or Chinese label mapping
result_semantics.null: defensively excluded by the application service; production schema declares questions.type NOT NULL
result_semantics.duplicates: removed defensively after the database DISTINCT
result_semantics.ordering: stable Java natural String order for the raw internal view; it is not the final HTTP label order
result_semantics.immutability: the returned list is an unmodifiable copy
result_semantics.failure: the original persistence exception propagates unchanged; route-specific translation is deferred to operations

query_budget.authentication_selects: not applicable to this internal capability; HTTP ownership remains deferred

shared_success.body: top-level JSON array of mapped Chinese labels
shared_success.mapping_order: map every eligible raw value, then deduplicate labels, then Python-sort the Chinese labels
shared_success.unknown_nonempty: mapped to 简答题 rather than discarded

authentication.anonymous: both routes return 302 Location /login before catalog SQL

ordinary_session./admin/api/types: 403 JSON message 需要管理员权限
ordinary_session./admin/types: 403 JSON message 需要管理员或科目管理员权限

subject_admin_session./admin/api/types: 403 JSON message 需要管理员权限

authentication.administrator_session: both routes return 200 and execute one catalog SELECT
authentication.valid_administrator_bearer_only: both routes return 302 Location /login because the global /admin gate does not treat the path as /api
authentication.administrator_session_plus_valid_bearer: both routes still return 302 Location /login because a valid Bearer bypasses the Web-session branch

route_specific_data_semantics./admin/api/types: strip the raw value first and omit values that become empty
route_specific_data_semantics./admin/types: test raw Python truthiness first; a whitespace-only nonempty value survives and maps to 简答题
route_specific_data_semantics.python_whitespace_requirement: Future projection must match Python str.strip semantics; Java trim or strip alone is not accepted without Unicode parity tests

/admin/api/types.database_failure_accept_any: 500 text/html with the fixed Chinese generic error page

cross_cutting_effects.allowed_runtime_effects: global session/user-state activity and possible users.last_active refresh are outside catalog facts
cross_cutting_effects.golden_side_effect_assertion: questions full-row fingerprint remains unchanged before and after every case

invariants: The catalog capability reads only the catalog-owned questions table.
One invocation executes one parameter-free SELECT and no catalog write.
Raw empty and whitespace values remain distinguishable for the future route-specific adapter.
No Chinese display label or HTTP error policy enters the catalog API, application service or domain.
Persistence failures propagate from catalog so operations can preserve each route's distinct failure policy.
The two HTTP operations remain operations-owned and pending; internal capability does not imply route migration.
The 50,000-row plan executes once, scans questions once and introduces no N+1 query.
PostgreSQL 16.14 and 18.4 execute the same adapter SQL against the production-compatible NOT NULL type schema.
No production type-only index is introduced without production telemetry and a separate migration decision.

required_before_phase4h_route_migration: approve and machine-check the HTTP owner dependency direction
implement Python-compatible Unicode whitespace and alias projection
implement modern 500 and legacy catch-to-empty failure adapters
add route delta and OpenAPI only after full golden parity
keep questions under the sole catalog data owner
